breakpoints: Mobile ≤640px: single-column layout, collapsible left nav, 44x44px touch targets
Tablet 641–1024px: two-column content, left nav visible, responsive grids
Desktop >1024px: three-column or content+side panel layouts
accessibility: Semantic headings and landmarks (header, main, nav, aside)
ARIA roles and labels for actionable lists and controls
Visible focus states and sufficient color contrast
Announce network status changes politely via aria-live
performance: Lazy-load QR data URLs and non-critical assets
Debounced/intervalled live updates with SSE watchdog
Avoid layout thrash; use CSS transforms and utility classes
Use system fonts + two webfonts; font-display swap
Minimize re-renders by memoizing derived data
realtime: SSE with auto-reconnect and 60s heartbeat watchdog
Offline banner pauses actions and resumes when online
